Alok Singh

Show Creator · Co-Founder · Technology

Alok Singh is associated with Gorakhpur's Got Latent (GGL) through its creative and digital work. His profile brings together show creation, technology and the online experience that helps audiences discover the platform.

Within the GGL team, Alok is credited as a Show Creator alongside Naveen Varma. His public-facing technical profile also identifies him with co-founder and technology responsibilities. The exact division of operational duties may evolve as the show grows.

Audiences may also hear the playful name “Computer Ji” in connection with Alok. It is a light-hearted show reference, not a separate official title or claim about the show's scoring system.

His technology interests include web development, product building, AI-enabled tools, digital experiences and the systems behind online platforms. In the GGL context, that means helping shape the website and the digital layer around the show.

Alok is also beginning a personal vlogging journey through @byaloklive. This is his creator-facing social account; its posts and activity should be checked directly on Instagram.
